209005.name: The bedroom

down.description: To the down lies In the Kitchen.

209005.description:
The vintner's bedroom is small and low, its whitewashed walls leaning in
under the slope of the roof and its dark beams close enough to touch. A
narrow bed with a patched quilt of dyed wool stands under the shuttered
window, and a pegged oak chest and a washstand fill the rest of the
space. The air smells faintly of grape must and old wood smoke. A narrow
stair leads down to the kitchen below.

209007.name: In the wine cellar

west.description: To the west lies The wine storage room.

up.description: To the up lies Inside a large building.

209007.description:
Brick vaults arch overhead in the vintner's cellar, and ranks of fat oak
casks lie on cradles down both sides, their heads marked in chalk with
the years of the vintages. The air is cool and still and sweet with the
smell of old wine soaked into the stone. Steps climb up to the pressing
house. A low door in the wall leads west to the storage room.

209008.name: The wine storage room

east.description: To the east lies In the wine cellar.

209008.description:
Racks of dusty bottles climb the walls of this low storage room, their
necks furred with grey, and everything is draped in cobwebs. Thick
silken cables of web span from rack to rack and across the ceiling, as
strong as ship's rope, and a dense white sheet of it clogs the far
corner. Something large has spun here, and the dust is scuffed in wide
ragged trails. The only way out is the door east to the cellar.

extra_descs.webs cobwebs cables web:
The strands are as thick as a thumb, grey and tacky with dust. Whatever
spun them has dragged heavy things through the tangle, and torn threads
hang in ragged loops.
